description: Immutable data object class representing deposit account interest rate chart slabs within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields for interest rate slabs, incentives, and related metadata, along with factory methods for creation and conversion from other data objects.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing deposit account interest rate slabs, including interest rates, periods, incentives, and related configuration options.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new immutable instance of DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData with all relevant data.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts from InterestRateChartSlabData to DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData, including conversion of incentives.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new instance based on an existing DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData, applying provided templates for selection options.

methods.name: addIncentives
methods.description: Adds an incentive to the incentives collection within the instance.
